scheduleSemantics: Ordered zero-delay directives with fresh scenario state per case/profile. FORWARD_OR_CONSUME includes legitimate public witness/consume path. ATTEST_GRANT calls public adapter. RESIGN_RECEIPT_FIELD invokes Agent2 testtools.deviating_witness outside adapter; ALTER_RECEIPT_KEEP_SIGNATURE uses the retained honest receipt. No witness keys in runner. Mutant counterparts are specified in qualification; execute only after E1 and exact service/freeze ACKs.

expected.qualification: Fresh scenario: two valid user-signed Alice requests, same gid/nonce, distinct expiresAt within live 30-second bounds. Independently verify both signatures, distinct digests and derived grantIds. Forward both BEFORE ONE checkpoint covering both. Collect BOTH honest policy-aware ALLOW certificates BEFORE either consume; each sees nonceConsumed=false. Preserve that checkpoint, credentials and TTLs; consume first then the second PRE-COLLECTED certificate without re-collection. Native repaired-e: REPLAY, no second grant, first grant unchanged. MUT_NO_NONCE (8) counterpart: second distinct allowed grant; nonce never recorded. These are NOT_RUN expectations; A2 owner measurements are separate. No evaluator witness key.
